items.title: Announcing Workload Identity and staged publishing
items.preview: In the Hex 2.6 announcement we said we were testing Workload Identity. It's now available to every package and organization on hex.pm. Workload Identity, sometimes also known as "Trusted Publishing", lets a GitHub Actions job publish packages and fetch an organization's private packages without storing a key. It comes with staged publishing, which holds releases published with a key or a workload identity until a person with two-factor authentication approves them on hex.pm.

items.title: Reproducible Builds in September 2026
items.preview: Welcome to the September 2026 report from the Reproducible Builds project! In our reports, we try to outline the most important things that we have been up to over the past month. As a quick recap about what problem our project intends to solve, whilst anyone may inspect the source code of free software for malicious flaws, almost all software is distributed to end users as pre-compiled binaries.
